speaker: SON
text: Papa, maine aapke account mein paise transfer kar diye hain, pachas hazar.

speaker: SON
text: Abhi thodi der pehle. NEFT kar diya hai, kal tak aa jayenge.

speaker: FATHER
text: Theek hai. Mujhe hospital ka payment karna hai parso tak, urgent hai.

speaker: SON
text: Ho jayega. Aur papa, agar koi call aaye bank se bolke aur OTP maange to mat batana, aaj kal bahut scam ho rahe hain.

speaker: FATHER
text: Haan mujhe pata hai, news mein dekha tha. Digital arrest wala.

speaker: SON
text: Bilkul. Koi bhi asli bank kabhi OTP nahi maangta.
